Subject: Pilot credits extension & burn rate check-in

Hi Sara — great to speak with you earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our call: 

- Pilot scope: conversational summaries + clinical note generation for a subset of internal workflows (20 clinicians, ~50 sessions/day).
- Estimated token volume: you mentioned ~2–3M tokens/month (range 1.5–4M depending on usage spikes). Please confirm if that still sounds right.
- Budget: you indicated $6k–$12k/month for this pilot. You also called out a target unit economics of ~$3,000 per 1M tokens (we'll use that as a working number).
- Ask: you requested an extension of the free credits to cover initial burst while you validate prompts and PII redaction workflows.

I've attached the usage export you shared (pilot-usage.csv) and looped in Dev to evaluate a credits extension. Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm expected monthly token range (reply to this thread).
2) If confirmed, we'll issue a one-time credits extension (typical sizes: 25k, 50k, 100k) and set a 7–14 day burn-rate check-in to reassess.
3) Dylan (CC) will set up a 30-min technical check-in to optimize prompts and batching.

If you can confirm the token range and preferred credits size today, we'll try to get approval before EOD.

Thanks — will follow up internally after your note.

Best,
